plannedAcceptanceCases.note: No ACCEPTANCE_CASES_v1.1.csv was attached to this run; the 155 planned acceptance cases were NOT executed. Tests below are new and map to requirement IDs.

performance.note: software rasteriser on a CI container CPU; NOT an Android device measurement

tests.name: new world is uninhabited with typed, range-checked planetary settings
Play never creates life in a sterile world
seeded generation is deterministic; different seeds differ
terrain sampling is identical at every LOD parametrisation; edits apply at all levels
manual edits override procedural regeneration; regeneration is selective and revertible
undo/redo of terrain strokes; undo after simulated time warns and keeps consequences
command idempotency: duplicate id has no further effect; reused id with other content fails; new id repeats
rejected commands are atomic: canonical state is unchanged
sea level, painted water and painted biome produce consistent results
subsurface volume: carve opens a real entrance in the shared frame; collision and undo
functional home: rooms, door navigation, object use; structure follows sculpted terrain
direct control overrides autonomy; release resumes the SAME individual with memory and needs intact
causal chain: terrain edit dries a river -> resident fails to drink -> belief revised -> provenance recorded
tests.note: chain: person.failed <- river.dried <- terrain.edited

tests.name: knowledge is personal: no omniscience; hearsay is tagged with source and lower confidence
cohorts: promotion debits exactly once, never duplicates identity, even on retry
interest-based detail: dormant people keep identity, memory and needs; coarse updates stay consequential
archive round-trip restores the same world; simulation continues identically (determinism)
tests.note: archive 143 KB

tests.name: corrupted, oversized, hostile and future-version archives are rejected without side effects
two-generation storage: a damaged newest save falls back to the previous generation
crash recovery: journaled commands after the last snapshot are replayed to the identical state
tests.note: replayed 5 commands

tests.name: a failed snapshot write leaves the previous save loadable; named snapshots restore
pending work (births) is applied exactly once across save/reload
autonomous civilisation: people found a settlement and construct a building themselves
tests.note: settlement after 0 days, building after 2 days, techs: fire,tools,farming

tests.name: ecology: suitability is not life; seeded plants grow, spread or die by climate; grazing and predation occur
tests.note: animals alive 0, hunts 8

tests.name: activities are bounded declarative graphs: validated, never executable code
dialogue: rule-based fallback is labelled; no generative output without a registered local model
tests.note: scripted: I am sure there is water at the place I call 6825 (I saw it myself).

tests.name: roles and exclusive control: visitors cannot edit; one controller per character
species: validated custom anatomy/lifecycle; artificial life has a different physiology
natural consequences reach player-built structures (flooding is not blocked by manual placement)
bounded history: event log is tiered and capped; key events are retained
kernel purity: no wall clock, unseeded randomness, network, eval or DOM in src/core; offline single file
tests.note: 12 kernel modules, shipped file 360 KB

tests.name: build is reproducible: rebuilding yields a byte-identical Living_World.html
catch-up and time control are bounded and explicit
scale: 150 people + 140 animals simulate within the per-tick budget on this machine
